title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 035
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute folder variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Folder outline with a short top tab and a flat lower body panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest closed folder shape with one top tab.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for striped or corner fold folders when the body should stay plain.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a basic closed folder with a short top tab and plain body.

items.depicts_observation: Folder outline with a top band stripe running across the upper body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a closed folder with a visible horizontal band across the body.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain folder when the upper stripe should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a horizontal band stripe across the folder body below the tab.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded folder outline with a folded top right corner panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a folder whose main cue is the folded panel at the top right.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for plain tab folders when the folded corner panel is visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot changes the top edge into a rounded body with a folded corner panel.

items.depicts_observation: Open folder outline with a front panel tilted downward from the tab edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a folder shown opened toward the viewer with a tilted front panel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the flatter open folder when the front panel tilt is the visible difference.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot angles the front folder panel downward to show the folder open toward the front.

items.depicts_observation: Open folder outline with a broad open mouth and a flatter front panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an open folder with a wider flatter front opening.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the more tilted open folder when the broad open mouth is the main cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot opens the folder into a wider flatter mouth instead of a sharply tilted front panel.
